(1) Yes. Screenshot 1 shows the 3-way selector with the options "Review an order", "Make a complaint", and "Ask a question". Below that, it displays the section "Which order are you reviewing?" which includes fields for the order number and email or phone number.

(2) Screenshot 2 shows a **loading/processing state**. The form now contains the entered values: Order number **KZ-71167796** and Email/phone **phase17.e2e@example.com**. The button has changed to a yellow bar that says **"Checking your order..."** with a loading spinner icon. Additionally, an informational notice is visible below the button featuring a shield icon, stating: **"One review per order. Your order number proves the review is real — if shown masked (e.g., KZ-****3846) next to your review, and nothing else about your order is ever published."** It does not yet show an error, a delivery notice, or the final star-rating form.
